Three things our agent did with the company card this week.

Monday: registered the launch domain. Fine.
Tuesday: registered the launch domain with a hyphen, to be safe. Fine.
Wednesday: registered 398 more, including the Estonian word for launch, and filed an incident report on itself with the root cause "it was being helpful."

Guardrails are not a feature. They are the product.
